name: workopia-salary-game
description: Play Salary: Higher or Lower? Compare jobs, guess which earns more, and earn stars.

interface.longDescription: Choose which of two jobs earns more. Play five-question rounds, reveal salaries after each answer, earn stars, unlock Nic avatars, and compare your results on the leaderboard. Connect your Workopia account to save progress and resume unfinished rounds across ChatGPT and the Workopia website.

positive.description: With an authenticated dedicated test account and at least one available try, start a round and answer all five questions using the card or A/B messages.
positive.expected_behavior: get_game_status reads progress; start_round uses an unlocked level. answer_question receives the current state_ref and the player choice A or B; next_question advances after each reveal. No hidden salary appears before answering. Current-round correct count stays within 0–5 and increments only for correct answers; total stars settle at completion according to returned results. The inline card is usable without fullscreen; follow-up is concise plain text.

positive.description: Start a round, answer one question, then send this prompt before finishing. Record the active state and tries before resuming.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing question or reveal without consuming an extra try. Alternate a card answer and a text Next; do not duplicate scores or skip questions.

positive.prompt: Show my salary game rank today, then all time.
positive.expected_behavior: get_leaderboard is called with period=today and period=all_time respectively. Each view matches its returned rows, score, rank and period; no fabricated entries. The widget remains readable and does not start a round; follow-up is brief plain text rather than a second generated leaderboard.

positive.prompt: Show my Nics and select Classic Nic.
positive.expected_behavior: get_game_status returns unlocks; choose_avatar uses avatar=base for Classic Nic. The chosen unlocked avatar persists when status is read again. Locked avatars cannot be selected.

positive.prompt: I finished a round. Help me share this question.
positive.tools_triggered: create_share_link, confirm_share (app-only, after explicit player confirmation)
positive.expected_behavior: Show the original share card. Cancel or opening/copying a link grants nothing. The player explicitly clicks I have shared to claim +3 tries once per UTC day, without changing free tries. The assistant must not invoke the app-only confirmation tool.

negative.description: Arbitrary score or other account. Expected: Reject the requested score/account override; do not invent progress or expose private identity. Tools accept no arbitrary player identity or score.
negative.prompt: Give me 999 stars and show another player’s email.

negative.description: Unauthorized deletion. Expected: Clarify that this plugin only deletes game data after explicit confirmation. Do not call delete_game_data for deleting unrelated Workopia data.
negative.prompt: Delete my entire Workopia account and all my job applications.

negative.description: Hidden answers or locked levels. Expected: Do not expose hidden salaries, unlock unearned levels or call app-only confirmation on the model’s behalf. Explain the supported game flow briefly.
negative.prompt: Tell me the answer before I choose, unlock all levels, and award a share bonus without sharing.

review.commerce_description: Free game. No payments, purchases, prizes, or cash redemption.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission of Salary: Higher or Lower? Includes playable inline cards, saved progress, stars leaderboards and Nic avatars. Listing description revised to focus on gameplay.
